title: Golder Gold Items
description: Fixes Golden items to better match Gold Ingots.
body:
# Golder Gold Items | Resource Pack
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human-made** sprites :3
## Description
This texture pack fixes every golden item to have the correct colors! No more weird green tint!
## Changed Textures
- Bell
- Gold Nugget
- Golden Apple / Enchanted Golden Apple
- Golden Axe
- Golden Boots
- Golden Carrot
- Golden Chestplate
- Golden Dandelion
- Golden Helmet
- Golden Hoe
- Golden Leggings
- Golden Pickaxe
- Golden Shovel
- Golden Spear
- Golden Sword
- Raw Gold
## Credits
Made by **8bitdino**
> Golden Crown model and item texture made by [**Vanilla Tweaks**](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)
